ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-16-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Susan Lee.
Petitioner:Wiefeng Li, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Jeffery Weifeng Li.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-02-2006 Reset To Mar-16-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: E. Bura, CSR: Vicki Gross.
Petitioner: Weifeng Li, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
Petitioner was not able to provide proof of publication to the court and advised the court that publication was performed in the Sun Reporter.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
Matter is continued to March 16, 2006 at 9 am in Dept. 218 for proof of original publication.
